name: timeline
title: Timeline
description: Virtualized timeline with time-scale bars, dependency paths, and snapped drag edits.

api.description: Virtualized timeline with shared row scroll, time-scale bars, dependency routing, and snapped drag edits. Requires @tanstack/react-virtual.

props.name: rows
props.description: Row models with id and label (required).

props.name: visibleRange
props.description: Inclusive ISO date range for the scale ({ start, end }) (required).

props.name: dependencies
props.description: Directed edges between row ids ({ fromId, toId }) drawn as dependency paths.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Fine tick unit for the time scale.

props.name: loading
props.description: Show placeholder rows and set aria-busy.

props.name: emptyContent
props.description: Content when there are no rows and loading is false.

props.name: overscan
props.description: Extra virtual rows rendered outside the viewport.

props.name: estimateRowSize
props.description: Estimated row height in pixels for virtualization. Defaults to the kit row height token.

props.name: onBarChange
props.description: Called when a bar finishes a pointer or keyboard edit with ISO start and due.

props.name: onRowClick
props.description: Called when a row is activated.

props.name: renderRowMeta
props.description: Optional trailing content in the row label column.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the treegrid. Defaults to the kit string catalogue. Override when the host supplies a visible heading.

props.name: label
props.description: Label column content (required). Prefer a string so the bar cell can reuse it as part of its accessible name.

props.name: start
props.description: ISO start date for the bar.

props.name: due
props.description: ISO due date for the bar.

props.name: progress
props.description: Optional completion fraction for the bar fill.

props.name: colorToken
props.description: CSS custom property name used as the bar fill, for example --success.

groups.title: Accessibility
groups.description: Treegrid name: Pass aria-label when a visible title is not enough; otherwise the catalogue default names the grid. Row labels: Prefer string labels so gridcells can announce the item. Non-string labels fall back to a catalogue item name. Live region: Drag and keyboard edits announce the new date range.
